description:
Comparable sales in the same building or block. Preserve original price,
    sale date, UPRN and `attrs_source`. Backfilled/modelled floor areas are
    estimates: their derived price per square metre is not directly observed.
    An EPC room count is not automatically a bedroom count. Review anomaly and
    category flags; they do not prove distress or justify silently removing
    lower contrary sales. Aggregate flags on duplicate identity/date/price
    tuples. Verify combined-unit/building-parent demises before treating them
    as flat comparables. Repeated sales of one unit are correlated evidence.
    Report selection and rejection reasons before applying adjustments.
    UK only. Costs 30 credits (30p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: property_comps
title: Comparable properties
